extraction_notes: Catalyst loadings are reported in the main text as Ru 2.0 wt-% and Cs 6.4 wt-% by ICP; surface area 35 m2/g. Main article reports STY but not catalyst mass, total flow, space velocity, outlet NH3, TOF, or time-on-stream. Figures S1-S3 and detailed experimental procedure are in Supporting Information, but SI data were not included in the provided text; those data were not extracted. Experimental equilibrium/dotted-line values in Figure 4 were omitted. Most figure-derived STY values are approximate readings from labelled axes; exact text values were used where printed.
